title: Mixed thresholds in the Lonely Runner Conjecture
summary: The Lonely Runner Conjecture states that if $k+1$ runners start at the same point on a unit-length circular track and run with distinct constant speeds, then each runner is at some time at least $1/(k+1)$-distant from every other runner. Equivalently, for every tuple of $k$ distinct positive integer speeds $s_1,\ldots,s_k$, there is a real number $t$ such that $\|s_i t\|\geq \frac{1}{k+1}$ for all $i$.
